text:
```yaml
name: Validate PR Title
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - opened
      - edited
      - synchronize

jobs:
  validate-pr-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate PR Title
        run: |
          # Use environment variables to avoid bash injection
          TITLE="${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          BODY="${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
          
          # Create a temporary file with the PR data
          echo "$TITLE" > /tmp/pr_title.txt
          echo "$BODY" > /tmp/pr_body.txt
          
          # Run the secure JavaScript validator
          node scripts/validate-pr-title.js
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
